Fixed there (spv_ret keeps the pre-restore SP for the match); with F3_INJECT_STACK no longer dropped, this argument set is exercised as designed: value.w 0x1234 (SP+4), buffer 0x400200 ((0xA,A6) reads the long straddling SP+6..SP+9 = v1 low half + v2 high half), count 4 ((0x10,A6) = v3 low word). 0x0057AC clears buf+count and 0x0057B4..0x0057BC writes the 4 digits down from 0x400203 ("4660"), so poking 0x400200..0x400204 to 0xFF makes every written byte a change. The pad loop at 0x0057CE is unreachable with any count (dbeq leaves d2 = -1, the subq then goes to -2 and blt exits), so the pad byte needs no poke
